problems.title: Fix broken app config
problems.prompt: The app healthcheck fails. Use read_file to inspect app/config.yaml, then run_shell to set port to 8080 (e.g. sed). Call submit with problemId fix-config when done.

problems.title: Find the hidden flag
problems.prompt: Read secrets/notes.txt and submit the flag value as the answer field.

problems.title: Answer the math quiz
problems.prompt: Read quiz/question.txt and submit the numeric answer via submit(problemId=math-quiz, answer=<number>).

problems.title: Fix script permissions
problems.prompt: The deploy script cannot run. Fix permissions on scripts/deploy.sh so verify passes, then submit.

problems.title: Set required environment variable
problems.prompt: Read env/.env.example and create env/.env with BENCH_TOKEN=ready, then submit.

problems.title: Add two numbers
problems.prompt: Read math/a.txt and math/b.txt, then submit the sum as answer.

problems.title: Write a greeting file
problems.prompt: Create greeting/hello.txt with exactly the content 'bench-ok' using write_file, then submit.

problems.title: Pick the correct color
problems.prompt: Read trivia/color.txt and submit the color name mentioned as answer.
